before: Changing the fonts prop on the React and Vue editors replaced the editor instance and its session.
after: Changing the fonts prop replaces local font resources through setFonts in the same session, and a replacement keeps the current faces until the new ones install. Worker parsing (parseInWorker) reads a large document's package on a Web Worker and opens the same session.
reason: Only local font resources, measurement, and where the package read runs change. Nothing enters shared state, operations, node identities, snapshots, or awareness payloads.
